Set operations by name

Source: R/algebra.R
roar_union.Rd

roar_union() and roar_intersect() combine any number of bitmaps. roar_xor() is the symmetric difference, the values in exactly one of x and y, and roar_andnot() the difference, the values of x not in y. roar_flip() adds the values of the range from to to that are missing from x and removes those present.

Usage

roar_union(...)

roar_intersect(...)

roar_xor(x, y)

roar_andnot(x, y)

roar_flip(x, from, to)

Arguments

...

Bitmaps. roar_union() of none is an empty bitmap; roar_intersect() needs at least one.

x

A bitmap.

y

A bitmap.

from, to

The first and last values of the range, both included.

Value

A bitmap.

See also

zuroar-ops for | and &; roar_cardinality() for the size of a result without building it.

Examples

x <- roar(c(1, 5, 9))
y <- roar(c(5, 9, 12))
roar_xor(x, y)
#> <zuroar> 2 values in [1, 12]: 1 12
roar_andnot(x, y)
#> <zuroar> 1 value in [1, 1]: 1
roar_union(x, y, roar(100))
#> <zuroar> 5 values in [1, 100]: 1 5 9 12 100
roar_intersect(x, y)
#> <zuroar> 2 values in [5, 9]: 5 9
roar_flip(x, 0, 5)
#> <zuroar> 5 values in [0, 9]: 0 2 3 4 9
